purpose: Falsification attack on the amphora-molecule-role-ranker flagship Phase-0 KPI (role-classification-kpi.v1.json, structural_inference_agreement_rate=1.0) by invoking the REAL production RDKit C++ FFI (amphora-rdkit-ffi molecule_facts, pinned RDKit 2026.03.2, the same bridge.cc logic the live checked Rust runtime uses) on real, named, cited, coating-relevant molecules held out of the self-authored 39-record known-answer fixture.

results.citation: 3,4-epoxycyclohexylmethyl 3,4-epoxycyclohexanecarboxylate (ERL-4221 / Dow CAS 2386-87-0, PubChem CID 68563), formula C14H20O4 MW 252.30
results.note: cycloaliphatic (non-glycidyl-ether) diepoxide resin adjacent to an ester carbonyl; fixture only carries glycidyl-ether/aromatic oxiranes plus one plain cyclohexene oxide, none ester-adjacent
real commercial ether-backbone diamine hardener class, absent from fixture (fixture diamines are all alkylene/aromatic/cycloaliphatic, no ether linkage)
mixed primary(2H)+secondary-ring(1H)+tertiary-ring(0H) nitrogen in one molecule; fixture's only piperazine (ambiguous-glycidyl-piperazine) has no free ring N-H

results.citation: diethyl 2-(butylamino)succinate -- monofunctional model of the Michael-adduct secondary amine in commercial aspartic-ester hardeners (e.g. Desmophen NH-series polyaspartics used in fast-cure protective/marine topcoats)
results.note: secondary amine N whose alpha-carbon itself bears a direct ester substituent (N-CH(CO2Et)-CH2CO2Et); tests that the carbonyl exclusion looks at the nitrogen's DIRECT neighbor atom (must not be a carbonyl carbon) and does not over-exclude a non-carbonyl alpha-carbon merely adjacent to an ester group

results.citation: N,N-dimethylbenzylamine (BDMA, CAS 103-83-3), a common epoxy cure accelerator/catalyst, not a stoichiometric hardener
results.note: hostile-null: a real catalyst molecule must fail closed (no reactive N-H), not be silently promoted to hardener stoichiometry

results.citation: 2-ethyl-4-methylimidazole (EMI-24, CAS 931-36-2), a latent epoxy curing agent that cures by anionic ring-opening homopolymerisation initiation, not stoichiometric amine N-H addition
results.note: hostile-null: the ring N-H is aromatic (pyrrole-type); counting it as a reactive amine hydrogen would fabricate a chemically meaningless AHEW for a catalyst whose real mechanism is not N-H addition

results.citation: 4,4'-diaminodiphenyl sulfone (DDS, CAS 80-08-0), a widely used high-Tg aromatic diamine curing agent
results.note: tests that the sulfonyl exclusion (correctly scoped to a nitrogen's direct sulfonyl neighbor per bridge.cc is_sulfonyl_sulfur) does not over-reach to an unrelated sulfone many bonds from the reactive anilines

results.citation: 4,4'-diaminodiphenylmethane (DDM/MDA, CAS 101-77-9), common aromatic diamine hardener and precursor of the fixture's tgddm resin
results.note: the free diamine itself is absent from the fixture (only its tetraglycidyl derivative, resin-tgddm, is present)

results.citation: diethyltoluenediamine (DETDA / Ethacure 100 congener, CAS 68479-98-1), sterically hindered fast-cure aromatic diamine hardener
results.note: alkyl-flanked (sterically hindered) aniline nitrogens; structural rule is silent on steric hindrance by design (kinetics, not stoichiometry) -- checks the handle still fires

results.citation: dicyandiamide (DICY, CAS 461-58-5), the most common latent one-part epoxy hardener
results.note: OPEN CHEMISTRY QUESTION, not scored pass/fail: DICY cures through a complex catalysed nitrile-addition/cyclisation mechanism, not simple 1:1 N-H:epoxide stoichiometry, so there is no uncontested 'correct' reactive_amine_hydrogen_count for AHEW purposes. Recorded for the module's docs/mission.md known-contradictions register, not as a refutation.
